newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUMA'S SUNDS WINS $35 MLN THAI ORDER.
newsitem.headline: RAUMA'S SUNDS WINS $35 MLN THAI ORDER.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Monday its Sunds Defibrator division had won a 35 million dollar order from Advance Agro Public of Thailand for pulp drying and baling technology and equipment.
"Valued at approximately $35 million, the order also includes equipment for wood chip handling," Rauma said in a statement.
For pulp drying, Sunds will supply a complete process installation, including a drying machine wet end, an airbone dryer, a cutter and a complete baling system, the company said.
It would also supply a chipper and other systems in a follow-up deal to a complete wood and chip handling system supplied in 1995.
"For Sunds Defibrator this is the largest order ever for this type of systems package," it said.
The new pulping line is due for start-up in November 1997, Rauma said. "After the expansion the mill will produce nearly 500,000 tonnes annually of fully bleached pulp," it said.
